atoms.text: Justine wants to go on a new adventure. Help her compare the distances between countries.
atoms.sound: Justine wants to go on a new adventure. Help her compare the distances between countries.

instruction.text: Look at the distances and then choose the correct answer.

atoms.a:
Spain to Chile is 6,453 miles.
Spain to South Africa is 5,196 miles.
atoms.b: South Africa is ((++closer_to further_away_from)) Spain than Chile is.

atoms.b: Denmark is ((++closer_to further_away_from)) the U.S. than India is.

instruction.text: Look at the distances and then choose the correct answer.

instruction.text: Justine took some photographs of the landmarks she saw on her trip around the world. Choose the correct answer.

atoms.b: The Taj Mahal is ((shorter ++taller)) than the Brandenburg Gate.
atoms.sound: The Taj Mahal is taller than the Brandenburg Gate.

atoms.b: The Space Needle is ((shorter ++taller)) than the Tikal Temple I.
atoms.sound: The Space Needle is taller than the Tikal Temple 1.

atoms.b: The Tikal Temple I is ((++shorter taller)) than the Taj Mahal.
atoms.sound: The Tikal Temple 1 is shorter than the Taj Mahal.

atoms.b: Brandenburg Gate is ((++shorter taller)) than the Tikal Temple I.
atoms.sound: Brandenburg Gate is shorter than the Tikal Temple 1.
